secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key for payment processing (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys).

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint).

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password for the support@sevebois.be email account (used by Nodemailer for booking/enquiry notifications).

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL
secrets.description: Manus Forge API base URL — needed for the /manus-storage/ image proxy and data API calls (images won't load without it).

secrets.name: BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Manus Forge API bearer token — paired with BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL for the storage proxy and data API.
